text: おれの　いった　とおり　だったろ？

structure.jp: おれの　いった　とおり

patterns.name: 〜とおり
patterns.explanation: とおり after a verb means 'exactly the way that'. いった　とおり = 'just as said'.

patterns.name: 〜の (doer)
patterns.explanation: Inside a phrase that describes a following word, の can stand in for が and show who did the action. おれの　いった = 'that I said'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だったろ is a clipped, rough form of だっただろう, which asks the listener to agree about something past. だったろ = 'it was, wasn't it'.
